Fields name::String: Human-readable theme name.seed::String: Primary seed hex color (e.g. "#6750A4").secondary_seed::Union{String,Nothing}: …

title: MaterialDocs.resolve_theme
text: resolve_theme(theme) → ThemeConfig Resolve a theme argument to a ThemeConfig. Accepts: A ThemeConfig (returned as-is)A Symbol naming a built-in theme (e.g. :default, :ocean_depth) Throws ArgumentError if the symbol is not a known built-in theme.

title: MaterialDocs.BUILTIN_THEMES
text: BUILTIN_THEMES :: Dict{Symbol,ThemeConfig} The twelve preset themes, keyed by name. Pass a key to Material3 or resolve_theme rather than indexing this directly: format = Material3(theme = :ocean_depth) Available keys: :default, :ocean_depth, :solar_flare, :midnight, :forest, :arctic, :rose_garden, …

title: MaterialDocs.load_theme
text: load_theme(path::String) → ThemeConfig Load a theme from a .materialdocs.toml file. Returns a ThemeConfig with all fields populated (missing fields use defaults). Throws ArgumentError if the file cannot be parsed or contains invalid values.

title: MaterialDocs.save_theme
text: save_theme(config::ThemeConfig, path::String) Write a ThemeConfig to a .materialdocs.toml file. Overwrites any existing file at path. The output is a clean, human-readable TOML file.

title: MaterialDocs.find_theme_toml
text: find_theme_toml(docs_dir::String) → Union{String, Nothing} Search for a .materialdocs.toml file in the given directory. Returns the absolute path if found, or nothing.

title: MaterialDocs.HCT
text: HCT A color in the HCT (Hue, Chroma, Tone) perceptual color space. Fields hue::Float64: 0–360 (circular). The perceived color on the color wheel.chroma::Float64: 0–~113 (gamut-dependent max). Saturation intensity.tone::Float64: 0 (black)–100 (white). Perceptual lightness (CIE L*).

title: MaterialDocs.hct
text:
hct(hex::AbstractString) → HCT Parse a hex color string (e.g. "#6750A4") to the HCT color space. Examples c = hct("#6750A4")
# HCT(281.8, 46.3, 40.0)  (approximately)

title: MaterialDocs.to_hex
text: to_hex(c::HCT) → String Convert an HCT color to the closest sRGB hex string ("#RRGGBB"). If the requested chroma is not achievable in sRGB, the maximum achievable chroma at the given hue and tone is used instead. Examples to_hex(HCT(281.8, 46.3, 40.0))  # "#6750A4" (approximately)

title: MaterialDocs.TonalPalette

title: MaterialDocs.tonal_palette
text:
tonal_palette(seed_hex::AbstractString) → TonalPalette Create a tonal palette from a seed hex color. Extracts hue and chroma from the seed using the HCT color space. Examples p = tonal_palette("#6750A4")
p[40]  # ≈ "#6750A4"
p[90]  # light container color

title: MaterialDocs.tone_at
text: tone_at(p::TonalPalette, tone::Int) → String Alias for p[tone]. Returns the hex color at the given tone.

title: MaterialDocs.precompute!
text: precompute!(p::TonalPalette) Eagerly compute and cache all standard MD3 tone stops.

title: MaterialDocs.contrast_ratio
text: contrast_ratio(hex1::AbstractString, hex2::AbstractString) → Float64 Compute the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between two hex colors. Returns a value in [1, 21]. A ratio ≥ 4.5 meets WCAG AA for normal text; ≥ 3.0 meets AA for large text; ≥ 7.0 meets AAA. Examples contrast_ratio("#000000", …

title: MaterialDocs.meets_aa
text:
meets_aa(hex_fg::AbstractString, hex_bg::AbstractString;
         large_text::Bool=false) → Bool Check if a foreground/background color pair meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements. Normal text requires ≥ 4.5:1; large text requires ≥ 3.0:1.

title: MaterialDocs.meets_aaa
text:
meets_aaa(hex_fg::AbstractString, hex_bg::AbstractString;
          large_text::Bool=false) → Bool Check if a foreground/background color pair meets WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast requirements. Normal text requires ≥ 7.0:1; large text requires ≥ 4.5:1.

title: MaterialDocs.lighter_tone
text: lighter_tone(tone::Float64, ratio::Float64) → Float64 Find the lightest tone (in CIE L*) that achieves at least the given contrast ratio against the input tone. Returns NaN if impossible.

title: MaterialDocs.darker_tone
text: darker_tone(tone::Float64, ratio::Float64) → Float64 Find the darkest tone (in CIE L*) that achieves at least the given contrast ratio against the input tone. Returns NaN if impossible.

title: Add MaterialDocs to your docs environment
text:
MaterialDocs belongs in docs/Project.toml, alongside Documenter — not in your package's own dependencies. It is only needed when building documentation. using Pkg
Pkg.activate("docs")
Pkg.add("MaterialDocs") Your docs/Project.toml should end up looking like this: [deps]
Documenter = …

title: Switch the format
text:
In docs/make.jl, swap Documenter.HTML for Material3: using Documenter, MaterialDocs, MyPackage

makedocs(
    sitename = "MyPackage.jl",
    modules  = [MyPackage],
    format   = Material3(),
    pages = [
        "Home" => "index.md",
        "API"  => "api.md",
    ],
)

title: Pick a theme
text: Twelve themes ship built in. Pass one by name: format = Material3(theme = :ocean_depth) See Theming for the full list, and for building your own from a seed color.

title: Add a dark mode toggle
text: By default the site follows the reader's system preference. To offer an explicit toggle in the navbar: format = Material3(dark_mode = :toggle)

title: Deploying
text:
MaterialDocs does not change how deployment works — keep using deploydocs: deploydocs(
    repo = "github.com/you/MyPackage.jl",
    devbranch = "main",
) Once deploydocs has published more than one version, the navbar version selector appears automatically. It reads the versions.js and …

title: Theming
text: A MaterialDocs theme is a ThemeConfig: a seed color, three font choices, a corner-radius preset, and optional per-role overrides. Everything else — all 34 MD3 color roles, in both light and dark — is derived from the seed.

title: Built-in themes
text: Pass any of these by name: format = Material3(theme = :ocean_depth) ThemeSeedDisplay / BodyCode:default#9558B2InterJetBrains Mono:ocean_depth#006B5EFira Sans / Source Sans 3Fira Code:solar_flare#B23C17Space Grotesk / DM SansJetBrains Mono:midnight#1A237EPlus Jakarta SansJetBrains …

title: Custom themes
text:
Build one from a seed color: format = Material3(theme = ThemeConfig(
    seed = "#2E7D32",
    display_font = "Literata",
    body_font = "Source Serif 4",
    code_font = "JetBrains Mono",
    corner_radius = :rounded,
)) Fonts are Google Fonts family names, requested automatically at build time.

title: Corner radius
text: corner_radius selects a shape scale. Values are the extra-small through full radii in pixels: PresetRadii (px):sharp0, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16:default4, 8, 12, 16, 28, full:rounded8, 12, 20, 28, 36, full:pill12, 16, 28, 36, 44, full

title: Secondary and tertiary seeds
text:
By default the secondary and tertiary palettes are derived from the primary seed — secondary at reduced chroma, tertiary rotated 60° around the hue circle. To control them directly: ThemeConfig(
    seed = "#1565C0",
    secondary_seed = "#00897B",
    tertiary_seed = "#E65100",
)

title: Overriding individual roles
text:
When you need one specific color to be exact, override the role by name. These are applied after generation, so they win over the derived value: ThemeConfig(
    seed = "#1565C0",
    custom_colors = Dict(
        "surface" => "#FAFAFA",
        "primary" => "#0D47A1",
    ),
) Generated roles are …

title: Configuration files
text:
A theme can live in docs/.materialdocs.toml instead of your make.jl: [theme]
name = "my-theme"
seed = "#1565C0"
secondary_seed = "#00897B"

[theme.fonts]
display = "Fira Sans"
body = "Source Sans 3"
code = "JetBrains Mono"

[theme.shape]
corner_radius = "default"    # sharp | default | rounded | …

title: Color Engine
text: MaterialDocs contains a pure-Julia port of Google's material-color-utilities. It is used to build themes, but it is a general-purpose color library and is exported for direct use.

title: HCT
text: HCT combines the hue and chroma of the CAM16 color appearance model with the lightness (L*) of CIELAB. Its value is that tone maps directly to contrast: two colors 40 tones apart have a predictable contrast ratio regardless of hue. That is what lets a whole palette be generated from one color …

title: Tonal palettes
text:
A TonalPalette is one hue and chroma sampled across the full tone range: p = tonal_palette("#6750A4")
tone_at(p, 40)   # the primary color in a light scheme
tone_at(p, 80)   # the primary color in a dark scheme
tone_at(p, 90)   # a light primary container Tones are cached as requested; precompute! …

title: Color schemes
text:
color_scheme generates the full set of 34 MD3 roles from a seed: light = color_scheme("#6750A4")
dark  = color_scheme("#6750A4"; dark = true)

light[:primary]
light[:on_primary_container]
light[:surface] color_scheme_pair returns both at once, which is what the writer uses: light, dark = …

title: Contrast
text:
contrast_ratio("#FFFFFF", "#6750A4")   # 6.44
meets_aa("#FFFFFF", "#6750A4")         # true
meets_aaa("#FFFFFF", "#6750A4")        # false contrast_ratio also accepts two tones directly, which is cheaper when working in HCT. To find a tone meeting a target ratio against a known one, use …

title: Generated CSS tokens
text:
At build time each role becomes a CSS custom property, with _ replaced by -: --md-sys-color-primary
--md-sys-color-on-primary-container
--md-sys-color-surface-container-high All 34 are emitted regardless of whether the bundled stylesheets use them, so custom CSS has the complete set available. …

title: Theme Editor
text:
editor rebuilds your documentation, serves it locally, and injects a floating panel that re-themes the real pages as you adjust them. You are editing your actual site, not a preview of swatches. using MaterialDocs
MaterialDocs.editor() That builds docs/make.jl, starts a server, and opens a browser.

title: Workflow
text: Adjust the seed color, fonts, and shape in the panel. The page re-themes live.Navigate around your real docs to check the theme against actual content.Click Copy TOML.Save it as docs/.materialdocs.toml. That file is picked up automatically on the next build — no make.jl change needed. See Theming.

title: Why it works
text: Every stylesheet rule references a var(--md-sys-*) custom property and never a literal color. The editor sets those properties on :root, so one assignment re-themes every component at once. The same HCT engine that runs at build time is ported into the panel, so what you see matches what Julia will …

title: Options
text:
MaterialDocs.editor(
    build = "docs/build",
    port = 8000,
    make = "docs/make.jl",
    theme = resolve_theme(:ocean_depth),
) make — the build script to run before serving, so you are always editing the current state of your sources. Pass nothing to skip the rebuild and serve whatever is …

text: ControlEffectSeedThe primary color everything else is derived fromBackground / TextOverride surface and on-surface directlySecondary / TertiaryOverride those palettes; empty means derive from the seedFontsDisplay, body, and code families, loaded from Google Fonts on demandCorner radiussharp, …

title: Configuration
text:
Every option is a keyword to Material3. format = Material3(
    theme = :ocean_depth,
    dark_mode = :toggle,
    toc_depth = 3,
    logo = "assets/logo.svg",
    favicon = "assets/favicon.ico",
)

title: theme
text: A built-in theme name (Symbol) or a ThemeConfig. Defaults to :default, which first checks for docs/.materialdocs.toml — see Theming.

title: dark_mode
text: How light and dark are chosen. Default :auto. ValueBehavior:autoFollows the reader's prefers-color-scheme:lightAlways light; no dark rules are emitted at all:darkAlways dark:toggleAdds a navbar toggle, remembered in localStorage

title: logo and favicon
text: Paths relative to docs/src, copied into the build: Material3(logo = "assets/logo.svg", favicon = "assets/favicon.ico") The logo appears in the navbar at 32px tall. SVG is recommended so it stays sharp in both themes.

title: footer
text: Extra HTML placed above the generated attribution line: Material3(footer = "Made with ❤️ and Julia")

title: toc_depth
text: Deepest heading level shown in the on-this-page rail. Between 2 and 4, default 3.

title: sidebar_collapsed
text: Start sidebar sections collapsed. Default false. Reader changes persist in localStorage either way.

title: repolink
text: The repository link in the navbar. Default :auto. ValueBehavior:autoDerived from Documenter's configured remotea StringUsed as the URL verbatimnothingNo link The icon and label follow the host — GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps are recognised, with a generic git icon otherwise. …

title: versions
text: Show the version selector when the site has been deployed with more than one version. Default true. It reads DOCUMENTER_CURRENT_VERSION from siteinfo.js and DOC_VERSIONS from ../versions.js — both written by deploydocs. On a local build neither exists, so the selector stays hidden and the two …

title: search
text: Enable the search bar and index. Default true. Search is entirely client-side: a JSON index is generated at build time and loaded on first use. Ctrl/Cmd+K opens it from anywhere.

title: prettyurls
text: Directory-style URLs (page/index.html, linked as ./page/). Default true. Set it to false, or condition it on CI, when the build needs to be opened from disk — see Getting Started.

title: custom_css and custom_js
text:
Extra files, relative to docs/src, copied in and linked after the generated assets: Material3(
    custom_css = ["assets/extra.css"],
    custom_js  = ["assets/extra.js"],
) Because all styling is driven by --md-sys-* custom properties, custom CSS should reference those tokens rather than literal …

title: analytics
text: A Google Analytics measurement ID: Material3(analytics = "G-XXXXXXXXXX")
